AnimationSelection.title: AnimationSelection

ArtifactReference.description:
A file the server produced. Clients address it only by ``artifact_id``.

A frame sequence is fetched one frame at a time with ``GET {uri}?frame=<index>``,
where 0 <= index < frame_count.
ArtifactReference.title: ArtifactReference

CandidateMetrics.description: Objective metrics (docs/ALGORITHMS.md §4). Slip is measured on the ORIGINAL interval.
CandidateMetrics.title: CandidateMetrics

CreateRepairJobRequest.description: The body of ``POST /v1/jobs``. Clients must also send an ``Idempotency-Key`` header.
CreateRepairJobRequest.title: CreateRepairJobRequest

DetectionConfig.description: Detection thresholds. Defaults are frozen under ALGORITHM_VERSION.
DetectionConfig.title: DetectionConfig

next_seq.description: Pass as after_seq on the next poll
next_seq.title: Next Seq

HumanDecision.description:
The stored decision. Comparing it with the model's recommendation gives the
agreement metric.

agreed.description: choice == model_recommended; null when no recommendation
agreed.title: Agreed

HumanDecision.title: HumanDecision

JobEvent.description: An append-only progress event. ``(job_id, seq)`` is unique and ``seq`` starts at 1.
JobEvent.title: JobEvent

Problem.description: An RFC 7807 problem detail, extended with a machine-readable ``code``.
Problem.title: Problem

ProductStats.description: Product metrics computed from the store (docs/METRICS.md).
ProductStats.title: ProductStats

SceneRef.description: An uploaded scene, inspected on upload so that job requests can be validated.
SceneRef.title: SceneRef

SkeletalScope.description:
The bone sets the repair works on, resolved by the server from the armature hierarchy.

- ``chain_bones``: the bones whose motion may change, for example thigh, shin, foot, toe.
- ``keyable_bones``: the subset of the chain that actually receives keys.
- ``context_bones``: read-only ancestors, used for the hip position and root motion.
SkeletalScope.title: SkeletalScope

TemporalScope.description:
The requested frame range plus context padding.

``context_start`` and ``context_end`` are derived properties, not serialized fields.
They are not clipped here. The server clips them to the scene range
when it resolves the scope.
TemporalScope.title: TemporalScope

VisualEvaluation.description:
A structured multimodal judgement of one candidate against the original.

Scores run from 1 (bad) to 5 (good). For ``artifacts_visible``, 5 means *no* visible
artifacts.
VisualEvaluation.title: VisualEvaluation

info.description: AI plans and evaluates; deterministic code executes; the animator decides. Every error body is an RFC 7807 Problem carrying a machine-readable `code`.

post.description: Allowed only in AWAITING_DECISION (otherwise 409 INVALID_STATE). Choosing A or B schedules the non-destructive apply (status APPLYING). REJECT_ALL moves the job to REJECTED. Choosing a FAILED candidate returns 422.
